query: SELECT pc.userId, pc.componentId, pc.status, u.name as userName, u.email as userEmail, c.code as componentCode, c.name as componentName FROM professor_components pc JOIN users u ON u.id = pc.userId JOIN components c ON c.id = pc.componentId WHERE pc.status = 'pending';
